title: When the Cellar Breaks
author: Wendell Coldharbour
blurb: Yara Okafor, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must learn the song's last verse without singing along before the harvest moon rises.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
